Alpha Pant Women's is a light, highly durable GORE-TEX pant designed for alpine travel, climbing and hiking, built as a lightweight, highly durable waterproof shell pant for rugged, unpredictable conditions. The innovative waist cinch holds fast and rides easily under a harness or hipbelt, and full side zips make on-and-off easy.
